## Checklist
- [ ] Tests pass (ruff, mypy, pytest)
- [ ] Authorization checked (who can call this?)
- [ ] No secrets in code, no patient data in logs
- [ ] DECISIONS.md / SCHEMA.md updated if needed
- [ ] Reviewed by teammate AND a fresh AI chat (different tool than the writer)
- [ ] If AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, SCHEMA.md or CONVENTIONS.md changed:
      both teammates re-upload them to their AI projects
